name: "Mar" the Fairy and the Water of Life
description:
I met a fairy in Ellinia that was busily studying the magic of life. Her name was Mar, and she took a look at the lifeless doll that was once my pet for me. She can bring it back to life with a Water of Life and a Life Scroll. I hear that she knows Cloy of Henesys... A pet trainer named Trainer Bartos in Henesys might know something about the scroll of life, so I should start there...
After easily passing the test Trainer Bartos of Henesys gave me, I got a hold of the Water of Life and Life Scroll and got them to Mar the Fairy. With her magical power and the items I got her, she turned the doll back into a living pet. I can hang out with him for a while longer now... Sweet...

name: Make a Match Cards Set
chain: Maple World's Unique Fun: Match Cards
description:
It seems that Casey in Henesys Park knows a way to have a different kind of fun in Maple World.
I met Casey in Henesys Park. He claimed he could make me something to entertain myself whenever I got tired of hunting if I brought him enough Monster Cards. Getting them should be easy. I just have to defeat any of the following monsters, scattered across Maple World: Blue Snail, Pig, Ribbon Pig, Octopus, Blue Mushroom, Horny Mushroom, Evil Eye, Curse Eye, Lupin, Cold Eye, Lorang, Tortie, Wraith, Drake, or Wild Kargo. I should try to gather them when I have time.
I brought the requested items to Casey in Henesys Park and received a Set of Match Cards! With this, I can play the Match Cards mini-game with other adventurers anywhere! I should remember to ask Casey if I want to know more about the mini-game.

name: Make a Slime & Mushroom Omok Set
description:
It seems that Casey in Henesys Park knows a way to have a different kind of fun in Maple World.
I met Casey in Henesys Park. He claimed he could make me something to entertain myself whenever I got tired of hunting and asked me to collect a few items. He said I can get them by defeating Stump, Slime, and Orange Mushroom, found around Henesys. I should try to gather them when I have the time.
I brought the requested items to Casey in Henesys Park and received a Slime & Mushroom Omok Set! With this, I can play the Omok mini-game with other adventurers anywhere! I should remember to ask Casey if I want to know more about the mini-game.

name: Make a Slime & Pig Omok Set
description:
It seems Casey in Henesys Park can make another type of Omok Set.
Casey in Henesys Park said he could make a new type of Omok Set if I brought him a few items. He said I can easily get them by defeating Stump, Slime, and Pig, found around Henesys. I should try to gather them when I have the time.
I brought the requested items to Casey in Henesys Park and received a Slime & Pig Omok Set! With this, I can play the Omok Mini-game with other adventurers anywhere! I should remember to ask Casey if I want to know more about the mini-game.

description:

name: Silas Irons in Need of an Apprentice
description:
The master blacksmith of Perion, Silas Irons, seems to be looking for someone worthy of becoming his apprentice.
The master blacksmith of Perion, Silas Irons, is giving me a test to see if I'm fit to become his apprentice. He said that a true blacksmith must have the required amount of strength and knowledge. He told me to defeat the monsters around Perion and bring back the raw ore they drop.
I passed the test given by Silas Irons, the master blacksmith of Perion. Does this mean I can become a true blacksmith in Maple World

name: A Blacksmith in My Own Right!
description:
It looks like Silas Irons, the master blacksmith of Perion, is finally ready to acknowledge my skills.
Silas Irons, the master blacksmith of Perion, was impressed by how much I've grown and suggested I show off my abilities. I need to defeat Dark Axe Stumps and Zombie Mushrooms, then create an Orihalcon Ingot and a Gold Ingot and bring them back to him.
Silas Irons, the master craftsman of Perion, was amazed by my work and handed me a Armor Crafting Catalyst. It seems to be a special item that can be used during crafting to alter the stats of equipment. Maybe I should give it a try.

name: Silas Irons in Need of Help
description:
It looks like Silas Irons, the master blacksmith of Perion, needs some help. Maybe I should go check in on him.
Silas Irons, the master blacksmith of Perion, received an important request, but he's been struggling because he's short on materials. I need to defeat Bubblings and bring back Mithril Ingot to help him out.
I delivered the items Silas Irons requested without any issues. At this rate, I might really be considered a fine apprentice.

name: Mr. Thunder in Need of an Apprentice
description:
It seems Mr. Thunder, the master weapon craftsman of Perion, is looking for someone worthy of becoming his apprentice.
Mr. Thunder, the master weapon craftsman of Perion, gave me a test when I asked to become his apprentice. He said that weapon crafting requires one to have the proper amount of strength and knowledge. He told me to use my Smithing skill to craft 1 Bronze Ingot and 1 Iron Ingot. As long as I have the materials, those shouldn't be too difficult to make.
I passed the test Mr. Thunder, the master weapon craftsman of Perion, gave me. Does this mean I can now become a true weapon craftsman of Maple World

name: A Weaponcrafter in My Own Right!
description:
It seems Mr. Thunder, the master weaponcrafter of Perion, is finally ready to acknowledge my weaponcrafting skills.
Mr. Thunder, the master weapon craftsman of Perion, was amazed by my growth and suggested that I show off my skills. I need to defeat Iron Hogs and craft 1 Monkey Wrench to bring back to him.
Mr. Thunder, the master weapon craftsman of Perion, was impressed by my craftsmanship and handed me a One-Handed Weapon Crafting Catalyst. It looks like a special item that can change an equipment's stats when used during crafting. Maybe I should try it out.

name: Mr. Thunder in Need of Help
description:
It looks like Mr. Thunder, the master weapon craftsman of Perion, could use some help. Maybe I should go check in on him.
Mr. Thunder, the master weapon craftsman of Perion, received an important request, but he's been having trouble because he's short on materials. I'll need to defeat some Axe Stumps and craft 10 Screws to help him out.
I was able to deliver the items Mr. Thunder asked for without any issues. At this rate, I might really be considered a fine apprentice.

name: Francois in Need of an Apprentice
description:
It seems Francois, the tailor of Ellinia, is looking for someone worthy of becoming his apprentice.
After I told Francois, the tailor of Ellinia, that I want to become his apprentice, he gave me a test. He told me tailoring requires one to have the right balance of skill and knowledge and asked me to defeat monsters near Ellinia and collect Leafs.
I passed the test given by Francois, the tailor of Ellinia. Does this mean I can now become a proper tailor of Maple World

name: A Tailor in My Own Right!
description:

Jay of Henesys mentioned that Chief Stan was an adventurer who traveled the world in the past, and suggested that if he could find the Old Chief Stan's Hammer lost long ago when he was young, he might regain his energy. I should inform Mrs. Ming Ming of this information. Only characters at Level 27 or higher can complete this quest.
I passed on Jay's advice to Mrs. Ming Ming of Henesys.

name: Chief Stan's Hammer
description:
Mrs. Ming Ming of Henesys seems to have another request.
Mrs. Ming Ming of Henesys asked me to look for the Old Chief Stan's Hammer for Chief Stan. Will I be able to find it while hunting Evil Eye deep inside the Ant Tunnel Nothing is certain, but if I ever get the chance to go to the Ant Tunnel, I should look for it. Only characters at Level 27 or higher can complete this quest.
I hunted Evil Eye deep inside the Ant Tunnel and finally found the Old Chief Stan's Hammer. I thought it couldn't be found since it was lost decades ago... By the way, Chief Stan really must have been an adventurer in the past.

name: Memories of Youth
description:
Mrs. Ming Ming of Henesys seems to want to deliver good news to Chief Stan.
Mrs. Ming Ming of Henesys asked me to deliver the freshly polished Chief Stan's Hammer to Chief Stan. She seems a bit cautious about handing it over herself.
I delivered the Chief Stan's Hammer to Chief Stan of Henesys, and he was extremely surprised yet overjoyed. Seeing his eyes sparkle like that, it looks as though he might set off on an adventure again right this moment! At any rate, I should report all of this back to Mrs. Ming Ming. Only characters at Level 27 or higher can complete this quest.

name: Regained Vitality
description:
Chief Stan of Henesys seems to have something he wants to tell Mrs. Ming Ming.
Chief Stan of Henesys asked me to tell Mrs. Ming Ming that he is sorry and grateful. However, the news that he has regained his vitality will likely be what makes her happiest. Only characters at Level 27 or higher can complete this quest.
I delivered Chief Stan's message to Mrs. Ming Ming of Henesys. She seems relieved and ready to prepare for the next town festival.

name: A Gift for Pia
description:
Camila of Henesys seems to have something on her mind.
I met Camila in Henesys, and it looks like she's fretting over a birthday present for yet another friend of hers in town, Pia. The trouble is, Pia is quite picky about her tastes, so Camila asked me to go find out what she'd like to receive. I hear I can find Pia over at Henesys Park. Only characters at Level 37 or higher can complete this quest.
I asked Pia what she'd like for her birthday, but she doesn't seem like she's about to give me a simple answer.

name: Pia's Mischievous Wish
description:
Pia over at Henesys Park seems to be mulling over what she'd like for her birthday present.
I met Pia at Henesys Park, and with a mischievous look on her face, she said what she'd really like as a birthday present is a Sparkling Glass Marble. The trouble is, that's the very same precious item Camila once gave to Utah as a birthday present... I'd better head back to Camila first. Only characters at Level 37 or higher can complete this quest.
Camila was taken aback to hear what Pia wants for her birthday.

name: Materials for a Special Marble
description:
Camila of Henesys seems to be worrying a great deal over Pia's birthday present.
It looks like Camila has decided to make a prettier, sturdier marble for Pia. For Camila's sake, let's head down into the Kerning City subway or the depths of the Ant Tunnel, defeat some Jr. Boogie 1 or Jr. Boogie 2, and gather Jr. Boogie Horn. Only characters at Level 37 or higher can complete this quest.
I brought Camila the item she asked for. Still, no matter how I look at it, it really seems like Pia is just trying to mess with Camila.

name: A Marble Made With Care
description:
Camila of Henesys seems to have finished the birthday present for Pia.
Camila asked me to deliver the birthday present to Pia on her behalf. Since it isn't the exact item Pia said she wanted, Camila seems quite worried about it. Still, it must've just been my imagination that Pia seemed to be thinking about Utah. Only characters at Level 37 or higher can complete this quest.
I delivered Camila's birthday present to Pia. Now that she's received it, Pia seems somehow flustered.

name: A Promise Between Three Friends
description:
Pia over at Henesys Park seems to have something she wants to tell Camila.
When I met Pia at Henesys Park, it turned out she was just a girl who wasn't very good at being honest about her feelings. Too embarrassed, or something like that. Still, somehow I think I understand how she feels. Pia asked me to go tell Camila that the two of them should visit Utah's farm together sometime. Those two are pretty cute, aren't they Only characters at Level 37 or higher can complete this quest.
I passed along Pia's suggestion to Camila at Henesys. I'm already curious to see what's in store for the three of them — Camila, Pia, and Utah.

name: An Unknown Savior
description:
Maya, who lives in the little mushroom house in Henesys, seems to have something on her mind.
Maya, who lives in the little mushroom house in Henesys, said that a while back, she wandered a bit further from town than usual to pick some delicious mushrooms, and stumbled upon a giant mushroom monster that put her in grave danger — until a warrior appeared out of nowhere and saved her. She wants to track him down and repay his kindness, but he vanished the moment he'd saved her, and she's had no way of finding him since. She's hoping I can help her find some clue. To find any leads, I should probably start by heading to the place where it all happened. It seems I need to look for the Giant Mushroom somewhere at Someone Else's House in Henesys. I suppose I'll have to take it down Only characters at Level 47 or higher can complete this quest.
I defeated the Giant Mushroom, Mushmom, that I encountered at Someone Else's House, and found Torn Note, which I brought back to Maya. Could this be a clue that leads me to that person

name: A Name on a Note
description:
Maya, who lives in the little mushroom house in Henesys, seems to want to follow the clue written on Torn Note.
From Torn Note, which I obtained after defeating Mushmom, the one who'd attacked Maya, I picked up two leads: Ellinia and Chrishrama. I think it'd be best to head to Sleepywood first and go hear what Chrishrama has to say. Only characters at Level 47 or higher can complete this quest.
I met Chrishrama at Sleepywood. It seems I might be able to track down the warrior who saved Maya more easily than I thought.

name: A Price to Pay
description:
Chrishrama, who I met at Sleepywood, seems to be hiding something.
Chrishrama, who I met at Sleepywood, wouldn't say a word, insisting that person wouldn't want to be known — but worn down by my persistent pleading, he reluctantly set one condition. That condition was for me to bring him Drake Skull for his research. It seems I should be able to get Drake Skulls by defeating Copper Drakes, found far off from Perion, or Drakes deep within the Ant Tunnel. Only characters at Level 47 or higher can complete this quest.
I handed over the Drake Skulls to Chrishrama, who I met at Sleepywood. Now it's time to hear his story about the warrior who saved Maya.

name: A Man Atoning
description:
It seems Chrishrama, who I met at Sleepywood, is finally about to reveal the secret.
Chrishrama, who I met at Sleepywood, told me to go find a man standing at the top of Perion. He clearly seems to know more than he's letting on, but for now he seems to be holding his tongue. Let's go find that warrior at Perion. Only characters at Level 47 or higher can complete this quest.
I met Manji at Perion. I don't think I've ever seen him look so flustered before.

name: A Name Never Given
description:
The warrior Maya had been searching for turned out to be Manji of Perion.
When I told Manji of Perion that Maya was looking for the one who'd saved her life, he seemed to waver for a moment — but then asked me to keep his secret, saying he didn't want her to know who he was. I wonder what I should tell Maya when I go back to her... Only characters at Level 47 or higher can complete this quest.
I returned to Maya at Henesys and told her what I'd learned about the one who'd saved her life. She seemed a little disappointed, but somehow looked happy all the same.

name: Becoming a Citizen of Honor
chain: A Gift for a Citizen of Honor
description:
I've finally been recognized as a Citizen of Honor of Henesys.
It seems Athena Pierce, who leads the town, is looking for me, so I should probably head over right away. Only characters at Level 57 or higher can complete this quest.
Athena Pierce of Henesys personally congratulated me on becoming a Citizen of Honor.

name: A Box Hidden Long Ago
chain: A Gift for a Citizen of Honor
description:
It seems Athena Pierce of Henesys has something to tell me now that I've become a Citizen of Honor.
Athena Pierce of Henesys said there was a gift prepared for me for becoming a Citizen of Honor, but that she'd give it to me if I could do her one favor first. She told me that a long, long time ago, she'd hidden a small box containing a bow somewhere in the Golem's Temple, but when she recently went to retrieve it, it was gone — and she asked me to go find that box for her. I wonder if Stone Golem or Dark Stone Golem out there might have it. Only characters at Level 57 or higher can complete this quest.
Why would Athena Pierce have hidden this box in a place like that, I wonder

name: A Worn-Out Bow
chain: A Gift for a Citizen of Honor
description:
It seems Athena Pierce of Henesys has yet another favor to ask.
Inside Athena Pierce's box was a small, old bow. But it had fallen apart after all that time, and Athena Pierce said Vicious should be able to fix it. It seems I should head to Vicious at Henesys Market and show them the bow. Still, if this bow is centuries old, just how many long years has Athena Pierce been alive for Only characters at Level 57 or higher can complete this quest.
I showed Broken Wooden Bow to Vicious. I hope he's able to fix it...

name: A Craftsman's Touch
chain: A Gift for a Citizen of Honor
description:
Can Vicious at Henesys Market fix Athena Pierce's bow
Vicious said the Broken Wooden Bow is made from a rare wood hardly ever found on Victoria Island, and asked me to gather Dragon Skin and Fragment of Magic as materials to repair the bow. It seems Dragon Skin can be obtained from Copper Drake, Drake, and Red Drake, while Fragment of Magic can be obtained from monsters imbued with magical energy, such as Malady, Stone Golem, and Dark Stone Golem. Only characters at Level 57 or higher can complete this quest.
I brought Vicious all the materials needed to repair the bow.

name: A Memory Restored
chain: A Gift for a Citizen of Honor
description:
It seems Vicious is about to show off his skill.
Vicious of Henesys Market, true to his reputation as the town's finest craftsman, repaired Athena Pierce's bow to perfection. All that's left now is to bring this Repaired Wooden Bow back to Athena Pierce. Only characters at Level 57 or higher can complete this quest.
I brought Repaired Wooden Bow to Athena Pierce and got to hear her story. That bow once belonged to a friend of hers from back when even Athena Pierce herself was still young and inexperienced — he'd passed away in a war fought centuries ago, and Athena Pierce had kept his bow all this time to remember him by. Athena Pierce thanked me for helping her recover a bow that held such precious memories, and gave me a small gift in return. I should treasure this Henesys Earrings she gave me too.

name: The Right to Own a Home
description:
Arthur of Henesys Town Hall seems to have a new offer for me.
Arthur of Henesys Town Hall said he had some good news, and told me that I'd been granted the right to own a house in this town. To hear more details, I should go find Tommy.
Tommy of Henesys Town Hall told me all about houses.

name: Looking for a House
description:
It seems Tommy of Henesys Town Hall has something more to tell me about houses.
Tommy of Henesys Town Hall suggested that if I want to get a house, I should go see Bianca. I should be able to find Bianca on the east side of Henesys.
It seems I can buy a house from Bianca of Henesys. I'll have to remember that.

name: To the Gray City, Kerning City
description:
Arthur, the Town Clerk of Henesys, seems to have another proposal.
Town Clerk Arthur of Henesys recommended listening to the explanation in Kerning City as well before deciding which city to become a resident of. Only characters at Level 12 or higher can complete this quest.
City Clerk Roxy, whom I met in Kerning City, suggested that I become a resident of Kerning City. Which city suits me better, Henesys or Kerning City Once I make up my mind, I should speak with the City Clerk of that city for more details.

name: First Greeting with Alex, the Town Resident
description:
It looks like Roxy, the City Clerk, is looking for someone to help with her work. Let's go check out Community Board in front of Kerning City Civic Center.
Roxy, the City Clerk, asked me to greet Alex, a resident of the city. Since I've become a resident here too, greeting the cityspeople is a given, right Only characters at Level 12 or higher can complete this quest.
I greeted Alex, a resident of Kerning City. As expected, the residents of this city seem to be quite full of personality.

name: Asking After Alex, the Town Resident
description:
It looks like Roxy, the City Clerk, is looking for someone to help with her work. Let's go check out Community Board in front of Kerning City Civic Center.
Roxy, the City Clerk, asked me to check on Alex, a resident of the city. Let's go see how Alex is doing. Only characters at Level 12 or higher can complete this quest.
I checked on Alex, a resident of Kerning City. In a city like this, no news is the best news.

description:
It looks like Roxy, the City Clerk, is looking for someone to help with her work. Let's go check out Community Board in front of Kerning City Civic Center.
Roxy, the City Clerk, asked me to check on Chun Ji, one of the residents. Ugh, do I really have to deal with that guy again... Only characters at Level 32 or higher can complete this quest.
I checked in on Chun Ji, a resident of Kerning City. They were as blunt as ever, but maybe we've gotten just a tiny bit closer.

description:

Roxy, the City Clerk, asked me to go say hello to Dark Lord, the hidden leader of the city. I'm a bit scared to say hello to Dark Lord for the first time. Only characters at Level 32 or higher can complete this quest.
I was able to say hello to Dark Lord, the hidden leader of Kerning City, for the first time. I felt completely overwhelmed by his presence.

description:

I checked in on Dark Lord, the hidden leader of Kerning City. Truth be told, he's someone who doesn't really need me checking in on him anyway.

description:
Roxy, the City Clerk, seems to be looking for items needed to manage Kerning City. Let's go see Community Board in front of Kerning City Civic Center.
Roxy, the City Clerk, requested a donation of 30 Red Snail Shells for Kerning City. Only characters at Level 12 or higher can complete this quest.
I gathered the items requested by Roxy, the City Clerk, and brought them to her. I'm glad I could contribute to the development of our town.

description:
Mong from Kong in Kerning City might know about a cure for a phobia of Stirge.
I have my doubts about whether Mong from Kong in Kerning City truly knows anything about Stirge, but as he says, I should look for the materials needed to craft the medicine. I need to defeat Bubbling and Stirge around Kerning City and collect 10 Bubbling's Huge Bubbles and 10 Stirge Wings. Only characters at Level 17 or higher can complete this quest.
I delivered the materials required to craft the medicine for the Stirge phobia to Mong from Kong in Kerning City.

name: The Final Ingredient for the Cure
description:
It seems like Mong from Kong in Kerning City still needs something else.
Claiming that he needs the final ingredient for the Stirge phobia cure, Mong from Kong in Kerning City asked me to go get a Vitamin Gummy from his grandfather, Mr. Goldstein in Lith Harbor. To think that Mr. Goldstein was Mong from Kong's grandfather... Only characters at Level 17 or higher can complete this quest.
Mr. Goldstein in Lith Harbor handed over the Vitamin Gummy with a suspicious look. Will this really be, okay

name: Grandfather's Vitamin Gummy
description:
It seems like Mr. Goldstein in Lith Harbor is willing to grant his grandson's request.
I obtained the final ingredient for the Stirge phobia cure, the Vitamin Gummy, from Mr. Goldstein in Lith Harbor. Now, all I need to do is bring this to Mong from Kong in Kerning City. Only characters at Level 17 or higher can complete this quest.
I delivered all the ingredients for the Stirge phobia cure to Mong from Kong in Kerning City. Now, I can only hope that he crafts the cure properly.

name: It's All in the Mind
description:
It seems like Mong from Kong in Kerning City has finally crafted the Stirge phobia cure.
I need to deliver the Special Stirge Phobia Cure crafted by Mong from Kong to Jake at the subway entrance in Kerning City. I hope this helps... Only characters at Level 17 or higher can complete this quest.
I delivered the Special Stirge Phobia Cure crafted by Mong from Kong to Jake at the subway entrance in Kerning City. Truth be told, it seems like a medicine with little to no actual effect, but if it gave Jake the courage he needed, perhaps that is enough.

name: A Lost Thank-You
description:
It seems Alex of Kerning City has something to tell me.
Alex of Kerning City said that even though he'd made up with his father, he'd already gotten used to his free life in Kerning City, so he was hesitant about going back home. In the meantime, he wanted to repay the people who'd helped him back when he first arrived in Kerning City and had such a rough time of it, so he'd prepared some gifts for them — but he'd gone and lost them in the marshland, and asked me to help him get them back. Let's defeat Ligator in the marshland near Kerning City and find Alex's Gift Sack. Only characters at Level 27 or higher can complete this quest.
I found Alex's Gift Sack in the marshland and brought it back to Alex.

name: Too Shy to Say It Himself
description:
It seems Alex of Kerning City has yet another favor to ask.
Alex of Kerning City asked me to deliver his gift to Nella for him. Apparently, he's too embarrassed to hand it over himself. Only characters at Level 27 or higher can complete this quest.
I handed A Gift for Nella over to Nella.

name: Nella's Old Memory
description:
Did Nella of Kerning City like Alex's gift
Nella of Kerning City seemed touched by Alex's gift. I should go let Alex know. Only characters at Level 27 or higher can complete this quest.
Alex seemed pleased to hear that Nella was happy with the gift. But it looks like he's still got another favor to ask, doesn't he

name: One More Debt to Repay
description:
It seems Alex of Kerning City has one last favor to ask.
Alex of Kerning City asked me to deliver his gift to JM From tha Streetz. Apparently he's too embarrassed to hand it over himself. Only characters at Level 27 or higher can complete this quest.
I handed A Gift for JM over to JM From tha Streetz.

name: Not Ready to Go Home Yet
description:
Did JM From tha Streetz of Kerning City like Alex's gift
JM From tha Streetz of Kerning City accepted Alex's gift with an air of indifference, but seemed secretly pleased deep down. I should go let Alex know. Only characters at Level 27 or higher can complete this quest.
Alex seemed happy to hear that JM From tha Streetz had secretly liked the gift. It seems Alex has learned a lot during his time here in Kerning City.

name: Worn Bandages
description:
It seems Jane Doe of Niora Hospital has a new favor to ask.
Jane Doe knew full well she wasn't among the living anymore, and yet she refused to accept it. Worried that Dr. Niora might never come back, she said she'd have to change her own bandages, and asked me to defeat Jr. Wraith and gather Tablecloth for her. Only characters at Level 37 or higher can complete this quest.
I gathered Tablecloths for Jane Doe. I only wish she hadn't asked me to help her change those bandages..

name: A Torn Letter
description:
It seems Jane Doe of Niora Hospital has yet another favor to ask.
Jane Doe of Niora Hospital said she simply couldn't bring herself to change her own bandages, and asked me to go find Dr. Niora. She said she'd found part of a letter Roxy had sent to Dr. Niora, and thought Roxy might know something about her whereabouts. I should go see Roxy at Kerning City Civic Center. Only characters at Level 37 or higher can complete this quest.
I met Roxy at Kerning City Civic Center. She clearly seems to know something.

name: Once a Renowned Doctor
description:
It seems Roxy of Kerning City Civic Center knows something about a doctor named Niora.
Roxy of Kerning City Civic Center told me what she knew. According to her, Niora was once a fairly well-known doctor here in Kerning City, but one day, after an accident at his hospital took the life of a young girl, he vanished from the city. She said she didn't know where Niora had gone, but suggested I go see Nella if I wanted to learn more. Only characters at Level 37 or higher can complete this quest.
I went to meet Nella to try and track down Dr. Niora's whereabouts. I do hope I can get some useful information out of this.

name: The Price of Information
description:
Does Nella of Kerning City actually know anything about the whereabouts of that doctor, Niora
Nella of Kerning City said she couldn't just hand over information for free, but promised to tell me what she knew if I took care of a job request that had just come in. Let's gather Fairy's Tentacles for her. Only characters at Level 37 or higher can complete this quest.
I brought Nella what she'd asked for. Now it's time to hear what she knows.

name: A Truth Finally Known
description:
It seems Nella of Kerning City is about to tell me what she knows about Dr. Niora.
I was able to learn a great deal from Nella. Niora was a doctor of considerable skill, but in the course of practicing medicine, he'd carried out all sorts of experiments on his patients, and patients' conditions had begun worsening at his hospital with increasing frequency. Then, one day, a young girl lost her life — and that was what finally brought Niora under Dark Lord's investigation. He was banished from the city and never returned. Which would mean that girl was... I suppose I'd better go see Jane Doe again. Only characters at Level 37 or higher can complete this quest.
I met Jane Doe and told her everything I'd learned. It seemed she'd finally, however painfully, come to understand that Niora was never coming back to this hospital.

name: A Quiet Line of Work
description:
It seems Chun Ji at Kerning City Construction Site has something to say.
Chun Ji at Kerning City Construction Site, unlike his brother Manji, a renowned swordsman, had secretly been doing exorcism work, hunting down evil spirits. He said he could sense the power of a strong evil spirit somewhere around Kerning City, and suggested that while he investigated elsewhere, I go investigate deep within the subway. If I ran into any Wraiths down there, it sounded like I'd need to defeat them all. Only characters at Level 47 or higher can complete this quest.
I defeated Wraith deep within the Kerning City subway and went back to Chun Ji. Still, there was something serious about the look on his face...

name: Another Lead
description:
It seems Chun Ji at Kerning City Construction Site is still lost in thought.
Chun Ji at Kerning City Construction Site said he could still sense the power of a strong evil spirit, and that something didn't seem right. Could it be that even after defeating all those evil spirits in the Kerning City subway, it still wasn't enough Just as Chun Ji suggested, I should go talk to Roxy at Kerning City Civic Center to get more information. Only characters at Level 47 or higher can complete this quest.
The moment Roxy at Kerning City Civic Center heard the word "evil spirit," she seemed to think of a certain girl...

name: A Name She Couldn't Say
description:
Does Roxy at Kerning City Civic Center know anything about the evil spirit somewhere in Kerning City
Roxy at Kerning City Civic Center couldn't hide the seriousness on her face when I mentioned that Chun Ji had been sensing a powerful evil spirit somewhere in Kerning City. After thinking it over for a while, she said the only one she could think of was the girl at Niora Hospital, and asked me to go check on Jane Doe. Something about this doesn't sit right with me... Only characters at Level 47 or higher can complete this quest.
After some hesitation, I went and met Jane Doe at Niora Hospital. But the girl I hadn't seen in a while... no, the girl's ghost, seemed to know something.

name: An Old Grudge
description:
It seems Jane Doe at Niora Hospital looks the same as always.
Jane Doe at Niora Hospital said there was a hidden passage on the first floor of Niora Hospital, and that she could sense an unusually powerful force coming from somewhere deep inside it, suggesting I go take a look. To think a passage had been hidden away in a place like that... There might be something dangerous down there, so I'd better be well prepared before investigating, and then head back to Roxy. Only characters at Level 47 or higher can complete this quest.
Deep within the hidden passage on the first floor of Niora Hospital, I came face to face with a powerful evil spirit. The spirit, named Shade, was consumed by such deep resentment that there was no reasoning with it, so I had no choice but to strike it down. Just what on earth happened in this place

name: An Unresolved Question
description:
It seems Roxy at Kerning City Civic Center looks somehow relieved.
Roxy at Kerning City Civic Center seemed genuinely glad, deep down, that the powerful evil spirit had turned out to be Shade, and not Jane Doe. Still, why had Shade come to hold such deep resentment, and just what had happened in that marshland connected to Niora Hospital Finding the answers to all of this doesn't seem like it'll be easy. It's about time I headed back to Chun Ji at Kerning City Construction Site. Only characters at Level 47 or higher can complete this quest.
Chun Ji at Kerning City Construction Site seemed relieved to hear that the powerful evil spirit, Shade, had been defeated, but there was still something about it that seemed to be bothering him. Still, it doesn't seem like there's anything more to find out for now.

name: Becoming a Citizen of Honor
chain: A Task for a Citizen of Honor
description:
I've finally been recognized as a Citizen of Honor of Kerning City.
It seems Dark Lord, the city's hidden leader, is looking for me, so I should probably head over right away. Only characters at Level 57 or higher can complete this quest.
Dark Lord at Thieves' Hideout personally congratulated me on becoming a Citizen of Honor.

name: A Missing Comrade
chain: A Task for a Citizen of Honor
description:
It seems Dark Lord of Kerning City has something to tell me now that I've become a Citizen of Honor.
Dark Lord of Kerning City said there was a gift prepared for me for becoming a Citizen of Honor, but that he'd give it to me once I completed one task. Dark Lord told me that long ago, not long after he'd first become the Dark Lord, a comrade of his had been kidnapped by a rival faction seeking to seize control of the city, and he entrusted me with the task of finding some clue to his whereabouts. He said the faction most likely responsible for the kidnapping had their hideout deep in the marshland, so I might be able to turn up a clue by defeating Croco there. Only characters at Level 57 or higher can complete this quest.
I found Encrypted Document in the marshland. Still, deciphering what was written on the document doesn't look like it'll be easy.

name: An Unbreakable Code
chain: A Task for a Citizen of Honor
description:
It seems Dark Lord at Thieves' Hideout has another task for me.
Dark Lord at Thieves' Hideout said there was someone who could decipher Encrypted Document, and told me to seek out an expert living somewhere deep in the marshland. It sounded like I could find him in a small cabin at Monkey Swamp III. Only characters at Level 57 or higher can complete this quest.
I met Slade, an expert in code-breaking, at The Hermit's Cabin.

name: What It Takes
chain: A Task for a Citizen of Honor
description:
Can Slade at The Hermit's Cabin really decipher Encrypted Document
Slade at The Hermit's Cabin said Encrypted Document had been intricately sealed with magical power, and that deciphering it would require something called Ink of Truth. He said Malady near Ellinia had it, so it sounded like I'd need to defeat them to get my hands on it. Only characters at Level 57 or higher can complete this quest.
I brought Slade at The Hermit's Cabin the item needed to decipher Encrypted Document.

name: The Weight of Truth
chain: A Task for a Citizen of Honor
description:
Can Slade at The Hermit's Cabin really decipher Encrypted Document
Slade at The Hermit's Cabin succeeded in deciphering Encrypted Document using Ink of Truth. But the look on Slade's face darkened as he read over the deciphered document... Anyway, I'd better bring this to Dark Lord at Kerning City right away. Only characters at Level 57 or higher can complete this quest.
I brought Deciphered Document to Dark Lord at Kerning City. Upon seeing the document, he fell silent for a long moment, having confirmed that Rex, once his comrade and friend, had sacrificed himself for his sake back then... Afterward, he told me I'd carried out the task admirably and handed me a gift. I think every time I look at this Kerning City Earrings, I'll be reminded of Dark Lord and his friend.

name: The Right to Own a Home
description:
It seems Roxy of Kerning City Civic Center has an exciting offer for me.
Roxy of Kerning City Civic Center said in an excited voice that she had good news, and told me I'd been granted the right to own a house in this town. To hear more details, I should go find Jack.
Jack of Kerning City Civic Center gruffly told me all about houses.

name: Looking for a House
description:
It seems Jack of Kerning City Civic Center has something more to say about houses.
Jack of Kerning City Civic Center gruffly told me that if I wanted a house, I should go see Scarlett. I should be able to find Scarlett in the center of Kerning City.
It seems I can buy a house from Scarlett of Kerning City. I'll have to remember that.

name: [Event] Founder's First Step
description:
A brand-new hero has just set foot in Maple World. Word is that the Maple Administrator in Henesys has prepared a welcome gift for every Founder who took that first step. Talk to the Maple Admin once a day to claim the reward for that day.
Today's gift have been claimed. Claim all 14 rewards and your first step will be complete.

name: [Event] The Journey Begins
description:
To celebrate the Grand Launch, the Maple Administrator in Henesys is handing out gifts to everyone starting their journey.
To celebrate the Grand Launch, the Maple Administrator is handing out gifts. A Maple Leaf might be dropped by monsters Lv. 10 and above. Bring them to the Maple Administrator in exchange for a gift. Only characters at Level 10 or higher can complete this quest.
Today's gift have been claimed. Claim all 14 rewards and your first step will be complete. Defeat monsters each day to receive that day's gift. The gift changes every day.

name: [Event] The Marks We Leave Behind
description:
Jay in Henesys says a very old adventure log turned up in the house study. It reads like the record of someone who once travelled Victoria Island, but the middle pages have been torn out, so there is no telling what it really says.
Jay found a tattered adventure log in the house study, and cannot make head or tail of it. The middle pages are gone, but the last page still reads: "Every hero leaves a mark. But only those who follow the trail will find it." A line like that only gets written down over a treasure worth hiding. Go and talk to Jay.
Jay is sure an adventurer like me can pick the trail back up, and handed over the Adventurer's Journal. Whatever is left of it, the first page is where this starts.

name: [Event] The First Mark
description:
The first page of the Adventurer's Journal is still legible. Let's see what is written on the first page.
The first page of the Adventurer's Journal reads: "Where the sea meets a shore guarded by little snouts." Only characters at Level 10 or higher can complete this quest.
Wedged in a crack in the rocks at The Pig Beach was the next sheet of the log. The Adventurer's Journal - Page 2 is mine. Whoever left this trail meant it to be followed.

name: [Event] The Second Mark
description:
The Adventurer's Journal - Page 2 carries a hint about the next place. This one leads inland, away from the shore.
The Adventurer's Journal - Page 2 reads: "I spent one night beneath a stranger's roof." Only characters at Level 10 or higher can complete this quest.
The monsters of Someone Else's House really were holding the next sheet. The Adventurer's Journal - Page 3 is mine.

name: [Event] The Third Mark
description:
The Adventurer's Journal - Page 3 carries a hint about the next place. This time the trail runs into the trees.
The Adventurer's Journal - Page 3 reads: "The forest remembers what the traveler forgets." Only characters at Level 10 or higher can complete this quest.
High up in Marr's Forest, an old tree had kept the next sheet all this time. The Adventurer's Journal - Page 4 is mine.

name: [Event] The Fourth Mark
description:
The Adventurer's Journal - Page 4 carries a hint about the next place. This one comes with a warning folded into it.
The Adventurer's Journal - Page 4 reads: "Where shadows gather, leave no coin unturned." Only characters at Level 10 or higher can complete this quest.
10 mesos was all the nameless thief ever wanted for it. The Adventurer's Journal - Page 5 is mine. Two pages left.

name: [Event] The Fifth Mark
description:
The Adventurer's Journal - Page 5 carries a hint about the next place. This one leads off the beaten path.
The Adventurer's Journal - Page 5 reads: "Beyond the familiar path, the wild ones roam." Only characters at Level 10 or higher can complete this quest.
The four scraps line up into a single sheet again. The Adventurer's Journal - Page 6 is mine. One page left!

name: [Event] The Final Mark
description:
The Adventurer's Journal - Page 6 carries the last hint in the log. Whatever the trail was leading to, it ends underground.
The Adventurer's Journal - Page 6 reads: "Beneath the earth, even the smallest footsteps may lead the way." Only characters at Level 10 or higher can complete this quest.
Past the hidden portal, at the end of Ant Tunnel Park, the trail finally ran out — and the Mark of the Beta was lying there waiting. "Every hero leaves a mark. But only those who follow the trail will find it." So that is what the log meant. The mark is mine now, and the next one is mine to leave.
